title: Ask the path inside holy company
summary: The path is shown where saintly company gathers around the Lord. Take the question into sangat.
lifeApplication: When the mind starts wandering alone, move toward the company that steadies it instead of asking isolation to save you.

source.shortMeaning: The path is shown where saintly company gathers around the Lord.
source.lifeApplication: When longing feels lost, move toward the congregation where the Lord is remembered.

evidence.coreClaim: The path is shown where saintly company gathers around the Lord.
evidence.turn: Longing ripens when saintly company shows the way.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the mind starts wandering alone, move toward the company that steadies it instead of asking isolation to save you.
